title: Intraperitoneal Insulin Tolerance Test in Mice
author: Fawaz G. Haj
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yp5fvq6

steps.title: Fast the mice
steps.instruction: Fast mice for 4 hours by removing food early in the morning (7:00am).

steps.title: Calibrate glucose meter
steps.instruction: Calibrate the glucose meter according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Measure baseline blood glucose
steps.instruction: Deprive mice of water and collect a baseline blood glucose measurement.

substeps.instruction: Remove approximately 5μl of blood (one drop) from the tail via a tail tip cut.
Transfer blood directly onto a glucose indicator strip.
Measure blood glucose immediately in a glucometer.

steps.title: Administer insulin injection
steps.instruction: Give the mouse an intraperitoneal injection of insulin (0.5 U/kg) using a 27 G needle.

steps.title: Monitor blood glucose levels
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples from the initial tail cut at specific intervals and monitor the animal.

substeps.instruction: Take blood samples at 15, 30, 45, 60, and 120 min post-injection.
Return the mouse to its cage between time points and monitor it every minute.

steps.title: Post-experiment tail care
steps.instruction: Ensure the tail is cleaned and bleeding has stopped before returning the animal to its cage.

substeps.instruction: Wipe the tail with 70% alcohol and allow it to dry.
Verify that blood loss from the tail has stopped.
